Supports steghide's pixel method (BMP, PNG), its DCT coefficient method (JPEG), PCM WAV LSB and MP3 frame padding. Runs entirely in your browser - your files never leave your device.

title: The Realtor Videos
excerpt: Dedicated Real Estate Video Hosting Platform — The Realtor Videos is a dedicated real estate video hosting platform that helps realtors, real estate agents, brokerages, and property developers host and share property videos without ads, suggested videos, or third-party branding. Generate clean video links, embed videos on listing websites, manage privacy settings, and track viewer engagement with built-in analytics.

title: LiteEditor
excerpt: A 41 KB rich-text editor with zero dependencies — LiteEditor is a lightweight rich-text editor built for the modern web. At about 41 KB gzipped with zero runtime dependencies and no jQuery, it delivers essential editing features including text formatting, tables, images, media, clean Word & Google Docs paste, and HTML output. Easy to integrate with a simple script — and currently completely free for everyone.

title: BLINKBUN Solana Token Checker
excerpt: Inspect Solana token data without connecting a wallet — A free, read-only Solana token checker for inspecting Mint Authority, Freeze Authority, supply, token-account concentration, DEX liquidity and market activity. No wallet connection, signature, seed phrase or private key is required. It shows verifiable public data instead of giving investment scores or buy/sell recommendations.

title: Alfredo
excerpt: A native Mac launcher that stays small and private — Alfredo is a launcher built the way Mac apps used to be: native Swift, about 45 MB idle, no Electron and no account. It keeps its own file index, updated through file system events, so search doesn't depend on Spotlight. Clipboard history stores text, images and files and pastes straight into the active app. Type 200+15% or "friday" and get the answer or a month grid right in the results. Everything stays on your Mac. Launching apps, file search and clipboard history are free, and will stay free

title: FitGate
excerpt: Turn your AI agent's approval prompts into micro-workouts — FitGate intercepts the moment your AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot CLI, Codex, Gemini CLI, Windsurf...) stops to ask "Do you want to proceed?" — and gates that approval behind a 10-second-to-2-minute micro-workout: push-ups, squats, a stretch, a 20-20-20 eye rest. You were about to sit and wait anyway. Now the wait makes you healthier. Free, open source (AGPL-3.0), runs offline forever, no account needed.

title: AdvantageBuilder: AI + Script Automation
excerpt: A unified workspace for coding, automation, and local AI — AdvantageBuilder gives scripts superpowers. It turns ordinary JavaScript and PowerShell into full desktop applications with GUI forms, workflows, scheduling, data access, and reusable automation. The new AI Integration Helper connects local models directly to your workflows, generating structured code, extending scripts, and automating tasks across all scripting engines. AdvantageBuilder is built for developers who want to go beyond scripts and create real applications powered by local AI.

title: CCC
excerpt: Your coding agents outgrew your terminal. One local board. — CCC puts every Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Grok, Kimi Code, OpenCode, and Devin session on one place and lets you build workers to run them autonomously Spawn sessions, steer any of them with follow-ups, queue work through Watchtower, and let it run unattended. I use it to fix customer reports overnight: an auditor files GitHub issues, CCC works the queue, I only approve go/no-go. Runs on your machine, stdlib Python, no cloud. Free for personal use, source on GitHub.

title: Ognom
excerpt: MongoDB, beautifully — Ognom is a free, open-source MongoDB desktop client. A fast native console with table and document views, an aggregation builder, a real shell, eight themes - and connections that know when they are production.

title: hob
excerpt: The professional workspace for your whole agent stack — Run complex agent work while staying in control. hob brings multiple models and independent workflows into one professional workspace. Agents can shape the workspace around each task, coordinate through it, and guide you inside it. Run, review, automate, and recover agent work in the same system, so you can direct more parallel work without piecing together the infrastructure.

title: Tvasta
excerpt: Local design–simulate loop for open CAD and FEA — Tvasta is a private preview of a local design–simulate loop on open tools (schema, hashed runs, a bounded agent). It does not replace Fusion or 3DEXPERIENCE and does not include CAM in this drop. Access is a pilot: we onboard a small number of teams and charge a fixed fee for the build plus hours. There is no public seat license and no hosted trial, because the kernel runs on your workstation. The gallery is that loop on the lighthouse part

title: DropBoard
excerpt: Drop a CSV. Get a dashboard. No signup, no server. — DropBoard turns any CSV into a live dashboard — entirely inside your browser tab. No account, no upload, no server: your data never leaves your machine. It auto-detects numeric and date columns, renders KPI cards, trend charts and distributions, with interactive filters and search. It ships as a single HTML file under 30 KB — download once, use forever, works offline. Export standalone HTML reports or PNG charts to share. Built for freelancers and small teams who want answers from their exp

title: SiftingIO
excerpt: One API for real-time and historical market data — SiftingIO gives developers one API for live and historical data across US stocks, forex, crypto, commodities and on-chain markets. REST, WebSocket, SDKs and MCP share consistent schemas, so teams can move from a quick prototype to production without rebuilding their data layer. Our goal is to make reliable market data easier to access and practical to use, whether you are an independent developer or part of a larger team.

title: AI Observability by OpenObserve
excerpt: OpenTelemetry-native observability for agents and LLMs — Your agent cost $40 and took 34 seconds. But why? OpenObserve traces every agent session across models, tools, services, datastores, and user sessions so you can see exactly where time, money, and quality went. Detect loops, run online evals, and follow failures from the LLM call through your backend and database, alongside the logs, traces, and metrics from the rest of your production stack.
